environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway HTTP API. Lambda connects to Aurora MySQL 8.0 cluster in same VPC topology. Database credentials retrieved from SSM Parameter Store path /prod/db/credentials-readonly. The MySQL user provisioned for this Lambda ('lambda_readonly_v2') was created with a restricted grant scope at the database level. Aurora cluster has query-level audit logging enabled via advanced auditing (server_audit_events=QUERY_DML) writing to CloudWatch. The RDS cluster parameter group sets 'read_only=1' at session level for connections from the Lambda subnet CIDR via mysql_native_password plugin configuration. Note: the credential rotation is handled by a separate Secrets Manager rotation Lambda that verifies grant integrity weekly.

config.db_user_grants: GRANT SELECT ON products_db.* TO 'lambda_readonly_v2'@'%'; REVOKE ALL ON *.* FROM 'lambda_readonly_v2'@'%'; GRANT SELECT ON products_db.products TO 'lambda_readonly_v2'@'%'; GRANT SELECT ON products_db.categories TO 'lambda_readonly_v2'@'%';
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, RDS in isolated subnet, SG allows 3306 from Lambda SG
config.grant_verification: Weekly rotation Lambda checks: SHOW GRANTS FOR lambda_readonly_v2 must match SELECT-only baseline
